# Wolfblanc Architects - International

> Wolfblanc is a Madrid-based international architecture and design studio working across Spain, Sweden and Greece. The practice combines Nordic precision, Mediterranean sensibility, local professional authority and direct senior involvement.

## Canonical website and language

- Canonical website: https://wolfblanc.com/
- Default language: English at root URLs; there is no `/en/` prefix.
- Spanish translations are available through the on-page EN/ES interface where complete.
- Local market websites: https://wolfblanc.es/, https://wolfblanc.se/ and https://wolfblanc.gr/
